objective: Make explicit Ollama screen analysis recover from empty or token-budget-truncated final content with one bounded second attempt, while continuing to discard hidden reasoning and preserving the no-pixel-retention boundary.
non_goals: Do not add or automatically switch to another vision provider or model.
Do not expose, log or return hidden reasoning, raw provider payloads, API keys or snapshot pixels.
Do not retry authentication, protocol, offline, timeout or capacity failures.
Do not add automatic/background capture, change observation TTL or enable autonomous decision support.
Do not open another product module or run repeat, soak or full release verification.
contracts: The first explicit vision request remains stream=false, think=false and bounded to 256 output tokens by default.

Only an empty final message or a response proven exhausted by done_reason/eval_count receives exactly one recovery attempt with a stricter direct-answer prompt and a bounded 768-token default ceiling.
A non-empty response marked token-budget-truncated is never accepted as a complete screen summary.
Hidden message.thinking content is never used as the summary, copied into the retry prompt, returned to the caller or written to logs.
Provider/auth/offline/timeout/protocol/capacity errors are propagated without a retry.
A local GPU lease covers both bounded attempts and is asserted after each provider response, then released exactly once.
allowed_dependencies: Existing Python standard library and pinned perception worker dependencies
oss_candidates: No new dependency; use the existing Ollama /api/chat response fields message.content, done_reason and eval_count.
acceptance_criteria: A fake empty-first/complete-second Cloud response returns the second final content after exactly two requests.
A fake length-truncated first response is retried and its partial content is never returned.
Two empty responses fail with E_PERCEPTION_VISION_EMPTY and two exhausted responses fail with E_PERCEPTION_VISION_TRUNCATED.
Authentication and other provider errors execute exactly one request and retain their original stable code.
Local lease tests prove both attempts share one lease that is asserted after each response and released once.
Fast perception tests and one bounded real MiniMax M3 Cloud smoke using a complex UI image return a complete Vietnamese summary without persisting the image.
